studies.title: The first modern atlas
studies.caption: Abraham Ortelius gathers maps of every region, drawn to one style and bound in one book, with a list of the cartographers he used.
studies.prompt: Close three-quarter view in Antwerp1570 of a large atlas open to a hand-colored regional map within a simple engraved ornamental margin; another loose copperplate map and pigments behind, reader turning a heavy page. No modern spiral binding, no legible text, no giant fantasy globe.
